name: Double Down
effects:
15 single-target hybrid attacks (0.60/1.50 each), Sync Mode, Cap Break Level 1, Quad Element Mode III & No Mercy to user
No Mercy: After using Defend Sync abilities under 0/1/2 Heavy Charge, grants [Cap Break Level 1/2/2 & Holy/Earth/Wind/Poison Ability Damage +15/30/30%] for 2 turns to user, -2 Heavy Charge
Quad Element Mode III: Lv.2 En-Holy Stack, Lv.2 En-Earth Stack, Lv.2 En-Wind Stack or Lv.2 En-Poison Stack
